launch.ask_agent: Build me a native 3D-tool UI panel with NVIDIA Omniverse `ovui` (the pip package) that renders headless on a CPU-only machine. Work in a clone of the `agent-next/sandbox` repo, under `cookbook/ovui-native-ui/`; read `cookbook/DEMO-STANDARD.md` and `cookbook/ovui-native-ui/SPEC.md` first. The panel must be a 420x360 `ui.Window` titled "Tool Panel" holding three labelled `FloatSlider` rows (ranges 0..10, 0..20, 0..50), a 140x24 `ColorWidget` swatch of colour rgba(0.2, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0), a `CheckBox`, and an "Apply" `Button` — exactly the widget tree SPEC.md fixes. Run `bash judge/setup.sh` once, then iterate: write `panel.py` with `build_panel() -> (window, refs)`, and run `bash judge/grade.sh panel.py --json /tmp/v.json` until every gate passes. Do not edit anything under `judge/` — the judge checksums itself and fails if it changed. Show me the final verdict JSON and the rendered PNG.
